articleTitle: Comparison methods of DCT, DWT and FFT techniques approach on lossy image compression
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper presents a study of image compression methods algorithm for compare the best techniques on lossy image compression. One of the major difficulties encountered in compression for lossy image that how to shield quality of image in a way that the compressed image constantly identical to the authentic, different from the types of methods that exist in the lossless image that can maintain the quality of the images authenticity. In compressing images there are also many methods that can be used with various algorithms such as Huffman code, Chandhuri and Hocquengham (BCH) Codes, Multiple-Tables Arithmetic Code, Fractal Coding, Block Truncation Coding and many other algorithms. In Transform domain, the image is for gain a rarely coefficient matrix using DWT, DCT and FFT. DCT method is almost similar to discrete Fourier transform (DFT), which works to convert a signal or image by a spatial domain into a frequency domain. Because amount variety of images, Binary Image, RGB image, image intensity. Then adopt compressing an image to decrease the size of the data or techniques to subtract the amount of bits required to reflect an images. Based on the results of this study using 3 methods that can perform compression image with different compression results with each method (DCT, FFT and DWT) as much as 4 variations of measurement percentage of image compression of each method starting from compressing image with size 10%, 30%, 50% and 70%. Comparing the three methods with four different variations of presentation measurement can give very accurate and clear results which method is best for compression the image of the present percentage size.

articleTitle: Alarm system to detect the location of IOT-based public vehicle accidents
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Traffic accidents are a thing that cannot be avoided by vehicle users. Many bus-related managers ignore vehicle engine maintenance from minor matters such as leaky fuel drains, supposedly replaceable vehicle brakes and short-circuit electrical connections. So in this study the author will make a fire detector and collision. The result of this tool will work when the MQ-135 sensor detects smoke, the fire sensor detects a fire and push button detects a collision. In addition to this tool also features GSM SIM800L module to provide information to the security agency. To facilitate the operation of the whole system is controlled by arduino uno microcontroller. After doing research MQ-135 sensor detects smoke when smoke comes into contact with the sensor, in addition to MQ-135 sensor in fire detection system used fire sensor module DFR0076, this module can detect fire up to distance 16 cm. While in the accident detection system (collision) is used push button. This tool system can be concluded that the overall design of the accident detection and fire detection equipment works well and the program used successfully applied to the system tool in accordance with the idea of design.

Author Keywords: Module GSM SIM800L and Arduino Uno)

articleTitle: Improving Naïve Bayes performance in single image pap smear using weighted principal component analysis (WPCA)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The accuracy value for single image classification of Pap smear for seven classes still has an unsatisfactory accuracy whereas the determination of cell classes in single image of Pap smear is very important to determine whether the cells are normal or not. Pap smear image classification that produces good accuracy will greatly assist in the process of detecting cells automatically. This study aims to determine whether the use of the method of weighted — Principal Component Analysis (PCA) models can improve the performance of the Naïve Bayes algorithm to classify cell images in the Herlev dataset. Accuracy will be checked for the classification of two classes and seven classes. The method used in this research consists of several stages that are preprocessing, knowledge rule, evaluation, and performance report. The results of this study indicate that the weighted PCA method can improve the accuracy on the classification of seven classes while the classification of two classes does not provide better accuracy results.

articleTitle: Developing potential agriculture land detector for determine suitable plant using Raspberry-Pi
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Potential agriculture land is essential to improve crop productivity. Unfortunately, the process of detecting good agricultural land is not easy, this cause problem when the plants used are unsuited to certain soil conditions and others parameter. This paper proposes a system for detecting the soil state by building a portable device using Raspberry-Pi and several sensors to obtain parameters of ground altitude, air humidity, soil moisture, and air temperature. The result shows the potential of the crop to be planted in the field, and provide the coordinates of each farming land to know the position of farmland. This research contributes to the improvement of agricultural produce, especially for farmers in determining the types of plants that suitable for planting.

articleTitle: Text mining for Indonesian translation of the Quran: A systematic review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Nowadays there is an increasing trend in computers used for learning Islamic knowledge from Indonesian Translation of AL-Quran (ITQ). As a result, substantial knowledge is stored in the form of unstructured text on chapters (surah) of ITQ. Text mining is exciting research area incorporated with information extraction, natural language processing, information retrieval, and data mining. It tries to discover knowledge from unstructured text. Text mining on ITQ is an ability to process Indonesian text into sentences (ayat) or documents (surah), interpret its text meaningfully, and identify as well as extract relationship among concept to directly answer the question of interest. This paper presents a review of concepts, searching and question answer (SQA) applications, and issues on text mining for ITQ. We reviewed the research papers highlighted some of the problems, gaps, critical challenges in this area and proposed some future research directions. Review method is composed of three phases: planning, conducting, and reporting the review. The results of this review show most existing research on text mining based on complexity, ambiguities, and optimizing for the SQA system application. Finally, this review can be beneficial to researchers in this area to carry it to the next level.

articleTitle: Design and performance of combine corn transplanter powered by hand tractor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Cultivation process consists of soil tillage, planting and fertilizer. These activities require a lot of energy if it's maked separately. The purpose of this research is to design and performance combine corn transplanter which can do cultivation process in single action. Type of starter fertilizer is NPK Soil tillage method applied is strip tillage. Testing of combine corn transplanter is performed by stationary test and field test. Performance of stationer test result showed that the combine corn transplanter could be metering 20.71 g/m NPK and 1-3 corn seed/hole, respectively. Performance of field test result showed that the combine corn transplanter could be metering 15.88 g/m NPK and 1-2 corn seed/hole, respectively. Mean corn seed spacing was 21.5 cm. Effective field capacity the combine corn transplanter was 0.147 ha/h (forward speed 0.83 m/s) and 0.350 ha/h (forward speed 1.25 m/s) and efficiency for respective speed was 76.24% and 83.78%.

articleTitle: NLOS and LOS of the 28 GHz bands millimeter-wave in 5G cellular networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: 5G cellular systems tend to operate at the centimeter-wave frequency band (3-30 GHz) or millimeter-wave frequency band (30 to 100 GHz). Line of Sight (LOS) is a direct line between the radio transmitter and receiver and many types of radio transmissions depend on it. Unfortunately, for arbitrary transmission networks, obstacles are commonly caused by non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions. This paper presents a comparison study of LOS and NLOS performance in the 28 GHz band for millimeter-Wave wireless networks, where a vast amount of underutilized bandwidth exists world-wide. This paper discusses the radio propagation mechanisms that impacts the performance of the network in the form of time delays, received power, azimut AoD, Evevation AoD, Azimut AoA, Elevation AoA, path-lost and RMS delay in LOS and NLOS environments.

articleTitle: Strain gage for mass sensor using cantilever beam
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Mass measuring devices have been developed by various methods. In its design, gauge the mass of the object to be adjusted in good measure the reach and shape. This corresponds to a sensitivity that can be generated by the mass measurement. One of the transducers for the measurement of mass that can detect small mass changes are the strain gage. In the making mass sensor using a strain gage type uniaxial with 120 ohm resistance and cantilever beam with a length of 2 cm, width 1 cm, thickness of 20μm that utilizes the deflection of the beam surface. The existence of deflection caused by the addition of mass at one end of the beam. Calibrated using the masses as loading balance brand ohaus Pioneer™ type PA214. Deflection that occurs detected a strain by strain gage transducers mounted on the cantilever surface. Through electronic wheatstone bridge circuit, the characteristic equation obtained by measuring the mass of the prototype instrument that states the relationship between voltage, V in millivolts, and the mass, m in grams, is V = -3.36667 m + 38.49556. This research will also be carried out data acquisition system to a PC to be stored in a database.

articleTitle: Depicting E-business application adoption for small and medium enterprises (SMEs): The e-business triangle model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Given the importance of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to economic development, both academics and policy makers have been interested in measuring the progression of SMEs' e-business adoption. Numerous ebusiness “stage models” for SMEs have previously been proposed to track such progression. However, there remain a few issues with these models. Previous models tend to be too linear and prescriptive of certain e-business applications for SMEs. The problem with this is that SMEs do not necessarily adopt application in linear fashion and given the diversity of SMEs, some applications may not be relevant for some SMEs. In addition, most of these models tend to overlook secondary value chain activities that support an enterprise. We thus proposed a model that attempts to address these issues. The proposed model, called the e-business triangle model, attempts to depict SMEs' adoption of e-business in non-linear way and categorizes them into new groups of activities, namely support activities, primary activities, integrated activities and analytics activities. To apply the model, we conducted a personally administered survey in two industries, trade and services, depicting different e-business adoption patterns between them.

articleTitle: People counting for indoor monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to develope an automatic system of people counting for indoor monitoring. People detection was performed using Histogram of Oriented Gradien (HOG) based feature descriptor and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classification. In this study several experiment were done to obtain best detection accuraccy i.e., Camera distance, light intensity and object distance. The result showed inaccurate detection is affected by the distance between camera and object, less of light intensity and objects coincide.

articleTitle: The performance of text file compression using Shannon-Fano and Huffman on small mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Textual information has grown tremendously generated from mobile user to digital libraries and archival text data from many internet sources. Many programs for data compression have been developed. However, mostly are only efficient to read small/brief files but inefficient, not even applicable, for very large files, especially on mobile devices. This is because the algorithm is too heavy to process and the design specification is to read short files that are repeated. In addition, large file sizes when transferred will require longer transfer times, larger space and higher costs, as file transfer rates are affected by internet network speed and file size. Text compression can be considered as a possible best approach in reducing storage space efficiently and accelerate transmission speed. In this study Shanno-Fano and Huffman algorithm has been evaluated and also the possible compression method on smartcard has been discussed. The aim of this study is to produce a compression method that produces text files with the smallest ratios and the fastest compression and de-compression times especially on mobile devices. This study improves file compression performance in order to obtain better file size, compression ratio, and compression time especially on text processing.

articleTitle: Development of offline handwritten signature authentication using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Handwritten signatures are playing an important role in finance, banking and education and more because it is considered to be the “seal of approval” and remains the most preferred means of authentication. In this paper, an offline handwritten signature authentication algorithm is proposed using Artificial Neural Network (ANN). As part of the feature extraction, two image filters were used, i.e. Canny edge detector and averaging filter. A feedforward neural network with 1 hidden layer was trained using backpropagation algorithm. The number of nodes in the hidden layer was varied from 80 to 1000. The higher the number of nodes, the higher the recognition rate. Moreover, we found that Canny edge detector is the suitable feature extraction as it produced higher recognition rate compared to the averaging filter.

articleTitle: Combination of AHP Method with C4.5 in the level classification level out students
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: One indicator of success in Higher Education is the high dropout rate, of course this condition will make a loss for both students and campus. The problem is the level of Drop out Students every year, especially in Indonesia tend to be unbalanced, that means the number of students who enter greater than students who come out. One of the reasons why the drop out rate in Campus XYZ is because the Management System has not been so well run, such as Lecturer Professionalism, Campus Facility, academic value of the student and the like. This study aims to analyze from several indicators that can be caused by Drop out by sorting the indicator by Analytical Hierarchy Process method. Where with this method can be found the sequence of problems so that the policy taken by the campus in the search for a solution. Also used is the Data Mining process by using Decision Tree C45 which aims to classify the existing dataset. This research contributes to the campus management in sorting indicators of the occurrence of Drop out students and the process of classification of each student, so it is expected to be one solution to solve the problem. The accuracy level resulting from C4.5 is about 97.67% with AUC of about 0.970% categorized as superior classification and AHP with a weighted value of 0.0866 for external effectindicator.

articleTitle: Development of automated antenna radiation pattern measurement using rotator application model to increase accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Measurement of antenna radiation pattern is an important process to validate the performance of the antenna. The extensive measurement system usually uses commercial equipment and works automatically. Unfortunately, the material used in an automated system is expensive, includes antenna rotator. For this reason, the majority of antenna measurement laboratories in Indonesia still adopts manual measurement. The problems encountered in manual measurement is low accuracy due to parallax error on reading data from network analyzer, and also the time required to measure an antenna is quite long. This paper proposed an automated antenna radiation pattern measurement system by constructing a two-axis antenna rotator positioner based on microcontroller and computer application program. The proposed system can increase the accuracy of radiation pattern plot and significantly reduce the time measurement. This paper contributed in providing low-cost automated antenna measurement system for utilization in the DTE laboratory University of Indonesia.

articleTitle: Design of composite material of rice straw fiber reinforced epoxy for automotive bumper
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In this study discusses the design of automotive bumper composite materials using rice straw fiber - epoxy, the method used in the process is filament winding method with the addition of NAOH and without NAOH on the cleaning process of rice straw fibers from impurities such as silica and lignin. The tensile result test which has been done is the fiber volume fraction of 10%, 20%, 30%, and 40% which obtained an average tensile strength 10% as 6.43 GPA, for 20% as 8.89 GPA, for 30% as 14.295 GPA, and 40% as 5.55 GPA. The composite material of epoxy rice straw fibers with the addition of NAOH obtained tensile test results at volume fraction of 10% as 6.99 GPA, 20% as 10.69 GPA, 30% as 14.76 GPA, and 40% having tensile strength as 8.54 GPA. These three volume fractions meet the criteria for automotive bumper material with tensile strength as 8.09 GPA.

articleTitle: Analysis of design combine transplanter power by hand tractor: Transmission system and furrow opener
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the process of designing machine requires a complete component analysis. The planter machine can do soil tillage, give starter fertilizer, Furrow Opener, seed place and furrow closer will be designed. Planter that does such integrated work is called a combine transplanter. This is done to achieve an effective and efficient planting machine. Therefore, an integrated planter machine will be designed using a tractor wheel axle as the driven. The purpose of this study is to analyze the transmission system on the planting tools and furrow opener to be used. The results showed that, transmission system recommended using sprocket-chain system. The number of sprocket teeth from the tractor wheel shaft up to the seed shaft has been obtained with a maximum spacing of 20.19 cm. Metering device fertilizer using edge-cell type with a gap area of 69.44 mm2 followed by cylinder dose of fertilizer. Furrow Opener will use a shoe type with a height of 10 cm, a width of 3 m and a thickness of 0.78 mm.

articleTitle: Analysis of ability to pay and willingness to pay for Jakarta light rail transit in Jakarta, Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This study aims to determine the tariff of Jakarta LRT based on the analysis of ability to pay and willingness to pay for taxi users. The ability to pay value analysis approach uses travel cost method and determination of willingness to pay value using discrete choice analysis. From the analysis results can be seen that the value of the ability to pay is Rp. 63.316 and the willingness to pay value is Rp. 11.500. This indicates that the willingness to pay taxi users is less than the ability to pay.

articleTitle: Measurement and modelling the drainage coefficient for hydraulic design criteria on residential area
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The incompatibilities of urban or residential area's drainage channel construction with design criteria were often found caused by the difficulties in designing drainage channel. This research aims to measuring drainage coefficient and modeling drainage channel's hydraulic design criteria in residential area. The model hydraulic design criteria of residential drainage system was able to be developed into nomogram. The width and height of channel can be determined using the nomogram according with the runoff. The residential drainage coefficient value was 0.28 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s.ha at 0–2 % slope and 162.9 mm design rainfall condition.

articleTitle: E-learning in Iraqi universities: A review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Electronic Learning (e-learning) is considered as an innovative approach to education delivery via electronic forms of information. e-learning is an online education or distance education, which means that it can deliver education to everyone around the world online through the electronic means such as the internet from different distant countries. The success of E-learning process in universities needs to some factors that should be fit with the revolution of technology and enhance the learner's knowledge. Universities in developing countries such as Iraq, in order to be fit with the rapid growth of technology, it needs to analyze the current capabilities, analyzing previous studies, evaluating it and developing solutions fit with the updated technology in which these countries could save the time and reduce the cost and offer modern alternative means, tools, and methods of e-learning in its universities This paper reviews e-learning studies and status in Iraqi universities, identifying gaps and proposed some alternative solutions for that in order to enhance the e-learning process in Iraqi universities.

articleTitle: Online information seeking behavior for cancer related disease: A developed and developing country comparison
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: With the rapid development of information and communication technology, seeking information over the internet has been time efficient and easily available regardless of time and place. The channels that provide information through internet have improvised and grown broader. The ubiquity of internet and availability of information has caused people to acquire information about health easily for their respective purposes. In this study, examination of information seeking behaviour through search engine for cancer related disease from developed and developing country was conducted, using Malaysia and Singapore as case studies. The content analysis technique is used to analyse the information seeking behaviour about cancer related disease. The findings show that there are differences in the pattern of information seeking behaviour between those from developed and developing nations.

articleTitle: Analysis deviation of direct measurement KWh meter in PLN P2TL Rayon Sukaraja Kab. Sukabumi
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: KWh meter is an essential element in the PT. PLN (Persero), because there listed electricity consumption. However, abnormalities in KWh meter intentional or unintentional will be influenced on the deviation value KWh meter, causing losses are difficult to identify. KWh meter inspection carried out regularly through P2TL activities in an effort to combat the shrinkage KWh. But the reality on the ground, implementation of P2TL in KWh meter inspection is less than optimal because the human resources are assigned in the field not understand KWh meter deviation calculation. The test is performed by examining how time that is obtained when KWh meter working. KWh meter is reading of energy usage in using the AVO meter in coverage of several impulses that appear on the indicator of KWh meter.

articleTitle: Factors influencing the user acceptance of integrated service management information system on local government in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Integrated Management Information System has been used and implemented in the Local Governments in Indonesia. In term of acceptance use by users has not been evaluated and measured yet. Factors affecting acceptance could be users' own internal or external factors. This paper aims to determine the factors that influence user acceptance of the implementation of the system. The local government who owns the system needs to know how many user acceptance factors correlation to system implementation. This study uses a model of the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) with variables used including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, habit, hedonic motivation, behavioral intention, and use behavior. The study was conducted to test the validity, reliability test, normality test, multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity test, and multiple regression analysis using the tools of IBM SPSS 20 and Microsoft Excel. Results of the study showed that the variables significantly affecting the user acceptance of the system is habit and facilitating conditions with 45% and 53.4% respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancement bandwidth of triangular microstrip antenna using peripheral slit technique fed by coplanar waveguide for mobile communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper proposed new design of triangular microstrip antenna using slit technique fed by coplanar waveguide to enhanced bandwidth for mobile communication purposes. Antenna designed using FR4 substrate with value (εr) = 4.3, substrate thickness (h) of 1.6 mm and loss tangent (tan δ) of 0.0265. From the simulation result shown return loss of -19.57 dB and VSWR 1.242 at work of frequency of 1800 MHz can be achieved by controlling the height of slit L1 and L2. Bandwidth of proposed antenna is 315 MHz which equal to an increase 61.53 % compared to the conventional triangular microstrip antenna and also the dimension of antenna can be reduced until 32.57 %.

articleTitle: Theoretical investigation of multiple tuned mass damper configurations subjected to step and periodic excitation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Tuned mass damper has been widely used to absorb the vibration of the external excitation due to its compactness, reliability, efficiency, and low maintenance cost. There are several types of tuned mass damper exist, but the most widely used is the translational tuned mass damper, which includes single tuned mass damper (STMD) and multiple tuned mass damper (MTMD). There were several approaches to study the performance of MTMD. However, there are a lot of high cost experimental research have been done. Regarding cost issue, study of performance using simulation could offer a solution. This research is focused on the effect of MTMD subjected to step and periodic excitation. The performance of MTMD has been analyzed and studied using simulation in terms of decay time, displacement amplitude of main structure, and any other observable phenomena. It has been found that increasing number of MTMD gives reduction of decay time in step and periodic input in series configuration. In addition, it leads to smoother movement response of the system.

articleTitle: Comparison of C4.5 method based optimization algorithm to determine eligibility of beneficiaries of direct community assistance (Case study: Kelurahan Cicurug)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The Provisional Direct Assistance to the Community (BLSM) is a program of providing cash assistance to Target Household (RTS), which is a Poor Household (RTM), which is stipulated by the government in addition to the fuel price hike. This study is based on the case that the distribution of BLSM is not the right target and subjective interests. This BLSM is for the poor who can not afford economically, but still many rich people who also receive it specially in Kelurahan Cicurug. Decision Support System (DSS) to determine the community direct assistance beneficiaries in Kelurahan Cicurug with C4.5 method is one of the above theme solutions. Data mining method is chosen because it can generate models and criteria that easily interpreted by the classification of Data Training and Data Testing with Genetic Algorithm (GA) algorithm so that it can be a better form of the method. Damp concluded with method C4.5 with accreditation value 92,92% from training data and 84,21% from data testing, Method C4.5 based on PSO have value 97,35% from training data and 98,68% from data testing, and GA-based C4.5 method has accreditation data of 94,69% from training data and 90,67% from data testing. Can be concluded C4.5 based on PSO is very good.

articleTitle: Participatory consensual assessment technique: End-users assessing outcomes of participatory design
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The use of participatory methods in the design of innovative software systems is increasing. However, when users design, the maturity of their design skills can result in nonoptimal solutions. Their produced designs may sometimes extend well beyond the intended scope of the designed system, are infeasible to implement, or meaningless to the target audience. An accepted solution to the problem is to let design experts assess and refine the artefacts designed in participation. However, including experts into the design process brings expert-centeredness into a participatory project, which can violate the basic philosophy of user-centeredness. Another solution is using end-users as judges of the design solutions. However, the quality and the validity of assessment in this case is often questioned. The authors postulate that if an appropriate evaluation technique is used, the users can produce valid and reliable assessments. In this paper, the authors report on the conception and evaluation of such an end-user based participatory assessment technique, namely Participatory Consensual Assessment Technique (PCAT). The authors stage a series of experiments in which end-users of a case tool (Jeliot Mobile) assess design ideas of the said tool by employing PCAT. The statistical analysis of the assessment data establishes the evidence that a subset of end-users when employing PCAT produces valid, reliable and consistent assessments.

articleTitle: Speaker identification based on curvlet transform technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Speech processing considered one of the most crucial areas of signal processing. Human speech is a natural form of communication, speech contains many information that can be used for determine the gender and identify of the person, thus we refer to biometrics technology, where speaker voice is considered one of the biometrics can be used for distinguished purpose. This paper presented simple speaker identification approach based on curvelet transform as a feature extraction technique and Backpropagation neural network BP NN as a classifier.

articleTitle: SMS based home appliance security approach using ROT 13, RC4 and RSA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This controlling and monitoring home and office appliances remotely and providing security when the users are away from home is a serious challenge facing the world today. The control of home appliances using plain text in a Short Messaging Service (SMS) was considered as insecure and has a potential to be used by man in the middle attack. This paper proposes an approach on development of SMS based home appliance security which securely used while the user is on move, away from their home. Firstly, the message was scramble using ROT13 and secondly it is encypted using RSA or RC4 algorithms. The length of the message after encryption process were compared along with the encryption and decryption time processing. Both aproaches show a satisfactory result based on the secure design specifications for the SMS based home security.

articleTitle: Factors influencing customers' intention to use Internet banking: MAYBANK2U in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Recently in years banks get an opportunity to serve their customers without the restriction of location and time, thanks to internet for internet banking facilities, but some customers still do not use it, because of different reasons. In order to understand this problem, this research aims to determine: whether there is any influence of trust and/or quality of system toward intention or desirability to do transaction online. Many complaints from customers related to system quality resulting in reduced of customer confidence in using Maybank2u. The analytical method used in this research in Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) using AMOS software version 22. Respondents of this research are customers of PT. Bank Maybank Indonesia's Branch Senayan 3, sampling method used was simple random sampling, with total number of 110 respondents answered the questionnaires. The results of this research are: (1) The existence of positive and significant effect of trust on the intention to do online transactions is 58%, (2) The existence of positive and significant impact on the quality of the system toward the intention to do of online transactions is 27%, (3) The influence of trust and quality of the system simultaneously toward the interest of doing online transactions is 85%.

articleTitle: Marketing strategy with linier regression to the interest of new students
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: One of the success of college is the amount of interest or desire of prospective students who will enter, and this will be a plus on the institution itself both in terms of financial and the existence of the college itself. The problem is that the value of interest rather than prospective students still at the end of the school level tends to be still a little because it is influenced by several other factors. So this study aims to analyze how much the value of interest than students who will go to college by processing existing data surveys in the field of data mining methods linear regression. Where with this method can analyze the tendency of interest than prospective students to get into college. This study provides a percentage value than the interest of prospective new students who will go to college. This research can help to know the interest of new student acceptance based on marking strategy factor such as campus facility, outside influences, campus information to students, academic, finance, student affairs and influence with marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Measurement of pyrolysis gases on palm oil shell and empty fruit bunch
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Flammable gases, char and liquid smoke can be obtained by pyrolysis process from palm oil shell and empty fruit bunch (EFB). Palm oil waste contains lignocellulose (cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin). Applied temperature on the pyrolysis process influences liquid, char and gases composition also pyrolysis product characteristic. The objective of this study is to measure produced gases on pyrolysis process of palm oil shell and EFB influenced by temperature. The experiment was conducted by using a pyrolysis reactor with temperature at 300°C, 400 °C, 500 °C and 600 °C. The result showed that shell pyrolysis produced char, liquid and gases mass fraction at the range of 34.99-63.78%, 22.76-43.28% and 13.47-21.73%. EFB pyrolysis produced char, liquid and gases mass fraction at the range of 30.66-64.76%, 16.25-29.16% and 18.98-44.49% Increasing temperature resulted in increasing char calorific value of both shell and EFB at the range of 25.64-29.60 kJ/g and 24.50-27.86 kJ/g. However, pyrolysis gas calorific value was decreasing with the increasing of temperature at the range of 12.18-20.05 kJ/g and 11.98-15.94 kJ/g. Increasing of shell temperature increased CO gas concentration at the range of 2.86-18.42% Increasing of EFB temperature increased CO and CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> gases concentration at the range of 3.81-15.74% and 0.29-0.76%.

articleTitle: OCW in implementation of CMA with private cloud computing-based to help informatics students to obtain professional certification in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of technology in education field. It is one of the alternative strategy to increase students' ability in certified informatics field in Indonesia. This paper explains how to create the infrastructure of e-learning (virtual classroom) by using Open Course Ware (OCW) with Cloud Computing-based to help informatics students to take the certification test. Furthermore, according to the regulation of National Professional Certification Institute (NPCI), PCI is prohibited to conduct training, PCI is only allowed to conduct competency test. It makes students difficult to take the competency test, since there is no training. Morever, the training is only conducted in big cities in Indonesia, while informatics study program is spread in all over Indonesia. From the problems above, there should be efforts to resolve it. The OCW is considered as a new platform in the field of educational technologies. It is expected to help informatics students to obtain certificate of competency, and also to fulfill the Minister of Education and Culture Regulation number 81 of 2014 regarding the diploma, certificate of competency, and professional certification of Higher Education. Certification is one of the SKPI documents that must be obtained by candidate degrees.

articleTitle: Design of smart mobility application to realize Sukabumi smart cities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Internet of Thing's or better known as IoT, is a concept that aims to expand the benefits of continuously connected internet connectivity. Internet of Things has several concepts and one of them is Smart Cities. The design of mobile applications that will author discussed focused on the design of the Smart Mobility is one part of the Smart Cities, which will design based mobile application maps will take advantage of GPS that has been provided by Smart Phone, where as to display the GUI (Grafical User Interface) on maps of the using help from the Google Maps API. The design of this mobile application using Java programming language, Android Studio version 2.3.3 and to connect with data base using google firebase. The design of this application is expected to help and realize sukabumi smart cities, with functions provided.

articleTitle: E-purchasing indirect material model using the open group architecture framework architecture development method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Factor for indirect goods and services is very important material to support the production activities as the absence of a system that integrates the purchasing department to another department that needs it. While in the process of procurement of goods and services for indirect materials still use the files. The problem is not integrated data and communication systems between the user in the procurement process and oversight issues of goods and services and indirect materials system development method used is the method TOGAF ADM (The Open Group Architecture Framework Architecture Development Method) with a focus on the design of phase F is Migration Planning and Governance Implementation phase G based Relation Unified Process (RUP). The result in the E-Purchasing Model is able to contribute to the company and the services desired information quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Towards an integrated framework of e-learning through an international innovative collaboration: Iraqi perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Electronic Learning (e-learning) is the process of offering education in a creative method by using the electronic shapes of information and contents. e-learning is the process of education that offered can be divided into online or distance education, which means that it can deliver education to everyone around the world online through the electronic means such as the internet from different distant countries. The success of E-learning process in universities needs to some factors that should be fit with the revolution of technology and enhance the learner's knowledge. Universities in developing countries such as Iraq, in order to be fit with the rapid growth of technology, it needs to collaborate with other national and international universities to develop e-learning tools and methods. In order to contribute to the success of the e-learning process in universities in Iraq, these universities have to adopt collaboration culture with other universities and adhocracy culture to follow the innovation in e-learning process. This paper proposes an integrated model of e-learning through an innovative collaboration environment which could participate to improve and add values to the e-learning process in universities in Iraq.

articleTitle: Optimizing the winglet model in getting the maximum power pressure using computational fluid dynamic (CFD)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the past, the wind tunnel is often used to test the performance of a component of aerodynamics. The number of components that used in these tests such as motion sensors, strain gauges and other measuring instruments, causing the cost of testing becomes very expensive. With the current technological developments, lots of software that can be used to test the performance of a component of aerodynamics. This research was conducted to provide solutions to the expensive cost of performance testing a component of aerodynamics. With the solid work software using, we can test the performance of a winglet model by way of creating a simulation of air flow through it, for more effective and efficient. In the study described the relationship between model winglet with angle ofattack of 10 °, 15 ° and 20 °. The results of this research show that the values obtained at the maximum press style model winglet type 2 registration-164.66 N at an angle of attack of 20 °. This research is expected to provide knowledge and guidance on installation of winglet on motorcycles.

articleTitle: Characterization of aluminum surface using image processing methods and artificial neural network methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The characterization of the material surface of the machine tool result should be known to assess quality of the product. Currently, the evaluation of product quality of machine tools is subjective. This study aims to characterize the surface of a metal, especially Aluminum based on image processing that metal displayed with computational approach using Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The specimen was worked by using several machines and different spindle rotation speeds and cutting speeds to obtain different surface roughness. The specimens were captured using a 4 mega pixel digital camera with the same source of illumination, with the same distance and pixel image. Aluminum image is further process to be identified with ANN. The results showed ANN 11 input 5 hidden model and 1 output; [11–5–1] showed the best results for identifying the surface of Aluminum with the smallest RMSE: 0.0038 for training and testing.

articleTitle: Design of 2.4 GHz Helix antenna for increasing wifi signal strength using Mmanagal and wirelesmon application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Helix antenna consists of a single conductor or multi-conductor open helix-shaped. Helix antenna has a three-dimensional shape. The shape of the helix antenna resembles a spring and the diameter and the distance between the windings of a certain size. This study aimed to design a signal amplifier wifi on 2.4 GHz. Materials used in the form of the pipe, copper wire, various connectors and wireless adapters and various other components. Mmmanagal describing simulation result on helix antenna. Further tested with wirelesmon software to test the wifi signal strength. The results are based Mmanagal, radiation patterns emitted achieve Ganin: 4.5 dBi horizontal polarization, F / B: -0,41dB; rear azimuth 1200 elevation 600, 2400 MHz, R27.9 and jX impedance -430.9, Elev: 64.40 real GND: 0.50 m height, and Wifi signal strength increased from 47% to 55%.

articleTitle: Roughness level analysis of the surface of plastic material from turning machinery process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The objectives of the research are to obtain the roughness surface level of plastic material resulted from turning process and to find out the effect of some elements of the machinning process to the surface roughness level. The material used are thermoplastic type which consist of polypropylene (PP) and polyvinilcloride (PVC), while the thermosetting plastic is consist of unsaturated polyester resin (UPPRs). The research design is divided into four steps; forming raw material, turning the specimen and roughness test and result analysis. PP and PVC specimens are formed with extrution machine and UPRs castingly. For each type of plastic is formed two specimens with dimension of 0 25 mm × 90 mm. The specimen are being turning gradually for 15 mm length. Machinning parameters are confined to 5 mm/sec feed with depth of cut 0.4 and 0.2 mm and speed are 350 rpm, 450 rpm, 550 rpm, 650 rpm, 750 rpm and 850 rpm. The result of the research shows the level of surface roughness of the plastic materials PP, PVC and UPRs had to decrease after the turning process. The level of surface roughness of these material after turning process around at the level N7 and N8. The machinibility of materials PP better than the PVC and UPRs materials.

articleTitle: Visual study of media images in the process of learning at deaf learners school
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The limitations in listening and speaking to deaf learners, causing them to rely on their visual ability to interact and capture knowledge. The image media is an alternative way in optimizing the visual potential of deaf students. However, in the use of media images, there are some things that are often forgotten by the teacher about visual studies. This resulted in the process of teaching and learning with the media of image runs less than optimal. So, this study aims to determine the visual assessment of the use of media images on the achievement of learning goals of deaf children. The method used in this research is mixed methods method with sequential exploratory research design, that is collecting and analyzing qualitative data then collecting and analyzing quantitative data. While the data collection techniques used are observation, interview, documentation and experiment study, using the data collection techniques it will be known more accurate results. From visual studies of the use of the image media can be concluded that visual studies can improve on the achievement of expected learning objectives.

articleTitle: The potential implementation of ‘DEGALANTIL’ using fuzzy logic analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)

authors.preferredName: I Gusti Bagus Ngurah Eka Darmaputra

abstract: In this recent years, most of young generation who live outside Bali start to leave out playing Gamelan or known as megambel, especially for playing gangsa. This condition due to limited number of accessible gamelan in public and the price of one set gamelan is relatively high. According to those problems, several researchers trying to find out the solution. One of the solution is trying to make a virtual gamelan application that can be installed and used in laptop, computer, or smartphones. However, its drive another problem in preserving nation's culture. Other researcher found a way to preserve the culture of Balinese Gamelan by creating an electric gamelan using tone dialing concept that is stored in a memory and connect to the microcontroller. That concept, encourage the authors to create a more efficient instrument by combining three types of gangsa into one instruments called DEGALANTIL (acronym of Pemade, Ugal, Kantil). Furthermore, authors collect data potential implementation of purposed electric gangsa through questionnaire. Finally, the collected data analyzed using Fuzzy analysis and the result shows very high potential to implement DEGALANTIL.

articleTitle: The effect of fiber orientations on the mechanical properties of ramie-sea sengon wood composites for wind turbin blades
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: The most important component of wind turbine is wind turbine blades. Wind turbine blades are mostly made from steel and aluminum. Unfortunately, this material is expensive and difficult to make because it increases the thickness of the laminate. In addition, the stiffness of the flap forms and lowers the natural frequency. Using composite materials in wind turbines is the best solution. Improving composite performance, such as making more resistant to impact, is a reference in wind turbine blade manufacture. The problems studied and searched for this research are fiber orientation (0°, 45°, 90°) and volume fraction (30%, 40% and 50%), on composite ramie fiber and sea sengon wood cores for the development of wind turbine blades, which can improve the mechanical properties of wind turbine blades. The making of the specimen utilized the compression molding method. The results depicted that the tensile strength for ramie fiber and core sea sengon wood was largest at 40% volume fraction of fiber direction 45° to the value of 27.13 MPa. The bending strength for ramie fiber core sea sengon wood was largest at 30% volume fraction of fiber direction 0° with a value of 5.08 MPa. It was expected that the use of ramie fiber and sea sengon wood as the substitutes for glass fibers in the development of wind turbine blades can improve the mechanical properties of the material of wind turbine blades that have been made previously.

articleTitle: Conceptual design hot press machine motif embossing continue pneumatic for syntetic material
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In the era of developing and automated as it is today, everything is required to be fast and timely. One of them is the entrepreneurial need to increase production capacity. Under these circumstances humans design a hot press machine with its suppressor using human power. But the hot press machine has a constant emphasis that the quality of production is not perfect. Seeing the problem, innovation is needed to get efficient results. One of them by designing pneumatic hot press printing machine. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to design conceptual pneumatic continuous system on hot press motif arising for synthetic material. Preparation of conceptual design of hot press machine with pneumatic starting with image design process, calculation analysis and machine planning. The press machine is designed to suppress the 520 N style using a 1.2 cm diameter cylinder rod, with a 3.2 cm diameter cylinder. Mattress width is, length: 30 mm, width 30 mm and minimum thickness 2 cm, with minimum thickness of 1 mm motif. The air discharge that must be flowed into the pneumatic cylinder is 0.48 ltr/min using a compressor power of 0.51 hp. Planning of installation of machine component that is covering cylinder base, ground work field, placement of pneumatic device, placement of heater and timer.

articleTitle: The need of rhetorical design on global brands' websites
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: In this internet era, consumers can easily open any website to seek information. Company website is an online media that provides information about the company and the product, and it can be accessed by the global internet user. Companies can use websites to enhance their interactions with the global audience especially their potential consumers on a global scale. Company website through internet connection enables global distribution of company and products information to the audience around the world. As the world became more globalize, Chinese companies also attempt to be more global. This article tried to analyze the Chinese companies' way of communicating to global audience through website; how far the progress they have created with the website to fit for global audience. This article analyzed “Top 100 Most Valuable Chinese Brands 2016” websites. In designing the website for global consumers (English version), Chinese company did not only translate with the same format, but they deliberately make some differences between the Chinese website and their English version website as the global web that are targeted to global audience. This article focused on visual literacy analysis of web designs, such as language, pictures, colors, and page layout. Some differences made in the English websites are more suitable for the global audience, but some other differences create a bad image for the company. Interview with global audiences are conducted to get some global consumer's experiences of the English version websites. To become a global company, they need to make an effective communication through website to provide a clear information to global consumer.

articleTitle: Efforts landslide on roads cijangkar Nyalindung district of Sukabumi
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Movement of soil mass or landslide is one of the most frequent natural disasters occur in the hilly areas in the tropics. Landslides often occur during the rainy season due to the additional load on the slope, digging or cutting foot of the slope, digging sharpen slope, change the position of the water level rapidly, the increase in lateral soil by water, vibration or earthquake that sometimes support these events. The research objective is: To know the major factors of the decline secure the slope and the road with and without reinforcement slopes. The method used in this research is the method Slope Stability Analysis diagram Taylor, Sliced methods and modelling with Software Plaids to analyze the stability of the slope on the road section Nyalindung District of Sukabumi. Analysis slope stability required soil parameters obtained from results of soil tests in the laboratory and in the field. Results of research to get the magnitude of what is safe slopes and a decrease in the road that will be used as prevention and mitigation of avalanche danger. The study was conducted during the two (2) years of which for the first year (2017), the target outcomes to be achieved is the analysis of Slope Stability in the District Nyalindung roads with Taylor diagram method and slices method. Research Year II (2018) is a modelling Slope on the road section to the District Nyalindung Software Plaxis.

articleTitle: Estimated budget construction housing using linear regression model easy and fast solutions accurate
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: An accurate cost estimate in the early stages of a construction project is very important, it is a key factor in the success of a project. But it is difficult to estimate construction costs quickly and accurately at the planning stage, when image data, documentation and the things are incomplete. The solution of the difficulty is the model, estimate the budget of the cost house construction using the model is an easy, fast and accurate way without have to prepare the image data and other documentation first, even just enough dreams, for example want to build a house with three bedrooms, Guests, dining room, kitchen, toilets, terrace, with the plan of their respective room, from the imagination of using the model can be predicted how much the construction cost is required. The suggested model has passed statistical test of linear regression analysis. Estimated construction project cost using model is easier, fast and accurate, so decision for making the investment feasibility can be done very quickly.

articleTitle: Remote patient monitoring system architecture for diabetes management
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing, Engineering, and Design (ICCED)
abstract: Health Information Technology (HIT) is becoming popular these days because of its immense benefits such as improving quality, efficiency and healthcare delivery. HIT can be used to provide medical services to patients from a distance typically via Internet or mobile phone services like SMS. Similarly, remote patient monitoring is a form of HIT that brings together the fields of information technology and medical sciences. Remote patient monitoring allows patients suffering from different diseases particularly chronic to be monitored, in order to have constant care. With remote patient application cost involved in managing a disease can be reduced and at the same time overcome the limitation of lack of specialists, resources, etc. Remote patient monitoring will be more interactive if it utilized Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS), because very often a response or decision is required when patients send their data to the healthcare centre in case of emergency. Also time spent on patients will be reduced, since the system will help doctors in making decision about their patients. However, nearly all the available remote monitoring applications are based on architectures that do not include CDSS feature, or are based on architectures that separate between Electronic Health Record (EHR) and CDSS module which are normally associated with interoperability problems. In this work we propose a complete remote patient monitoring architecture which uses EHR to make decision about patients suffering from diabetes.
